turns.prompt: power station to run a heated blanket all night
queries: EcoFlow DELTA 2 Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 Anker SOLIX C1000 battery capacity official specifications heated blanket
turns.answer:
To run an electric heated blanket all night (8–10 hours), I'd recommend a portable power station with at least 1,000Wh battery capacity, preferably using LiFePO4 batteries.

The right size depends on how much electricity your blanket uses and whether you run it on low, medium, or high.

How much battery capacity do you need?

Assuming 85% usable energy after inverter losses:

These estimates assume continuous power draw. Some blankets cycle their heating elements, reducing average consumption.

My recommendation: A 1,000–1,100Wh power station is a good starting point for a typical 50–100W blanket, especially on lower heat settings. For 100W continuously over 10 hours, choose at least 1,200Wh.
